license.notice: This sample pack is original to the rebuild and is not converted from the historical duckycodess/Battle-City stage data. It exists so the opt-in level schema version 2 terrain -- directional conveyors and one teleport pair -- can be loaded, played and captured without touching the three classic stages, which are the project's regression fixtures. NOASSERTION matches the classic pack rather than claiming a licence this project has not chosen for its content.
